playroom.reference: GCN Baby Park in Mario Kart 8 Deluxe
playroom.notes: Retains two straightaways and two hairpins. Rotates the map horizontally and uses the Castle Playroom, with project race length and item rules.

kitchen.notes: Traced the east start straight, diagonal return, west straight and infield hook. Project-sized curb and soft rail.

mermaid_pool.notes: Traced both straight bridge crossings, the central S and lower hairpin. Bridge decks are continuous to suit the no-fail driving rules.

opera_hall.notes: Traced the main switchback route, following the inside of the short fork along the bottom straight. Rounded corners, soft rails and no fall-off hazard.

runtime_art: Existing room backdrop PNGs and room item cutouts, loaded at original paths. Canvas atlas regions trim transparent padding for scenery footing. Ground is drawn from the physics centerline. Reference maps remain local review material and provide no runtime pixels.
